messages:
maria: Heads-up: reproducible on mac sample app after lid-sleep -> reconnect. SSE stream sometimes delivers the final token twice, parser bails with "malformed-final-token".

maria: Steps: run sample app, start streaming, close lid to trigger sleep, open lid. App reconnects auto and we get duplicated tail fragment + final marker. macOS 13/14 observed.

samir: Can you dump the raw stream around the reconnect?

maria: Pasted below (sanitized). you can see the last fragment replayed then [DONE] again:
```
[2026-03-10T09:02:11.001Z] RECV: data: {"id":"msg-42","chunk":"...partA"}
[2026-03-10T09:02:11.200Z] RECV: data: {"id":"msg-42","chunk":"partB-final"}
[2026-03-10T09:02:13.800Z] NETWORK: TCP FIN (system sleep)
[2026-03-10T09:02:18.100Z] RECONNECT_ATTEMPT
[2026-03-10T09:02:18.110Z] RECV: data: {"id":"msg-42","chunk":"partB-final"}
[2026-03-10T09:02:18.111Z] RECV: data: [DONE]
[2026-03-10T09:02:18.112Z] CLIENT: parser error -> unexpected duplicate final token
```

maria: Observed behavior: client-side parser is strict and treats second [DONE] as protocol violation.

ben: Notes from SDKs: Python path uses last-event-id + dedupe on reconnect. Node historically replays in-flight buffer when doing auth refresh/retry. iOS/Swift sample app client currently replays fragments on reconnect too. Looks like parity gap.

shay (cc tay): Any chance the sample app's reconnect logic queues leftover chunks?

tay: Swift client keeps a small write-buffer and will attempt to re-emit unacknowledged pieces on reconnect if not marked completed. This is probably why the final chunk was replayed.

samir: Two-pronged approach: short-term tolerate duplicate finals; long-term converge on idempotent fragment handling (sequence numbers / last-event-id).

ben: Quick fix idea: set a transient flag `final_seen_for_id:<id>` for the stream session TTL ~5s. If set, ignore subsequent [DONE]/final tokens for same id. Low risk and will stop flakes.

maria: I'll try that locally. If it fixes, we can ship a tiny patch in sample app and the Swift SDK. I'll also add a unit test that simulates TCP FIN + immediate reconnect with duplicate final.

tay: Add a note to onboarding docs: "Desktop sleep may cause ephemeral TCP teardown; clients must be tolerant of duplicate trailing tokens or implement idempotent fragment handling." Helps SRE and new devs.

samir: Also open a parity checklist item: ensure Node/Python/Swift implement consistent reconnect semantics (use last-event-id + dedupe or sequence-based gating).

maria: I can open PRs: one for the sample app quick tolerance patch + tests, another for the Swift SDK change. Will link here.

ci-bot: CI triggered: sampleapp/streaming #489 (waiting for tests)

ben: :thumbsup: on the quick fix. Also include telemetry to count duplicate-final incidents so we can measure prevalence.

maria: Good call. I'll add an internal metric `client.duplicate_final_count` with stream id tag.

samir: Thanks everyone. Once PRs are up ping me and I'll help with the parity checklist and release notes.
